US10482911.title: Solid-state battery cell with sulfide electrolyte interlayer

claims.1: A solid-state cell comprising a sulfide electrolyte interlayer between 1 and 20 micrometres thick disposed between a lithium-metal anode and a composite cathode.
claims.7: A method of forming the cell of claim 1 wherein the interlayer is deposited by cold sintering at below 300 C.

US11002000.title: Composite cathode coating for sulfide solid-state cells

claims.1: A cathode particle coated with a lithium niobate layer of 5 to 50 nanometres for use against a sulfide electrolyte.
A lithium cell with a two-layer polymer electrolyte.
A sulfide glass electrolyte comprising lithium, phosphorus and sulfur in a 3:1:4 ratio.

US20210123456.title: Anode current collector with lithiophilic coating

claims.1: A current collector bearing a silver nanoparticle coating.
A solid-state cell wherein the interlayer has a corrugated interface with the anode.
A sulfide interlayer doped with lithium chloride.
A roll-to-roll process depositing a sulfide interlayer at line speed above 5 m/min.
